notes: Covers the merged Devin + Windsurf pricing (windsurf.com/pricing now redirects to devin.ai/pricing after Cognition's July 2025 acquisition). Notable arc: $500/mo minimum → $20 entry (96% cut) → credits retired for daily/weekly quotas. Legacy ACU unit: 1 ACU ≈ 15 min of active agent work (reported).

change_events.description: Devin 2.0: entry price dropped from $500/mo minimum (Team: 250 ACUs) to a $20 pay-as-you-go Core plan — a ~96% entry-price cut, widely covered as opening the coding-agent price war.

Post-Windsurf merge: credit system retired entirely in favor of daily/weekly usage quotas; Windsurf Pro $15→$20; $200 Max tier added; Windsurf pricing merged into unified Devin plans (date reported only; corroborated by live redirect of windsurf.com/pricing).
change_events.user_reaction: Mild complaints on the $15→$20 rise; minor vs acquisition drama
